case.focus: listing org.judgmentpack.annotations in the supported-extension set changes nothing: it is not requirable, so the draft's section 8.2 ignores it

heldCases.heldBecause: The released case schema's supportedExtensions refuses every org.judgmentpack. name (conformance/evaluation/manifest.schema.json, $defs/extensionName), so this row cannot be stated in it unchanged. The draft's section 8.2 says a name that is not requirable is ignored. The row is released when the case schema of the version that carries RFC 0031 admits specification-defined names (RFC 0031, Graduation).
